授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: This is an advanced course for reading and writing academic English aiming to develop advanced reading skills and the ability to write a research paper in about 800 words. To be able to read papers on various topics, students will be required to read articles in a variety of genres and formats from National Geographic. In addition, class activity and tasks are intended to help students to build ability for critical thinking. Evaluation for this course includes the results of vocabulary tests (10%) using 『Word Quest』（九大出版会）
